text: CoinPay needs first-party merchant plugins for WooCommerce and WHMCS so merchants can accept crypto and credit card payments through CoinPay with minimal setup, consistent branding, and a unified API experience.
rewrite: CoinPay 需要为 WooCommerce 和 WHMCS 提供第一方商户插件，使商户能够通过 CoinPay 接受加密货币和信用卡支付；插件需在【待定：可检查的配置步骤数或时间阈值】内完成配置；插件需保持一致的品牌呈现；插件需提供统一的 API 体验。

text: Logs should be human-readable and processable by standard Unix utilities
rewrite: 日志应满足【待定：可检查的人类可读性标准】；日志应能被标准 Unix 工具处理。

text: User Story (Elena): "As a research scientist, I want to create, save, and load a recipe that specifies which material to use at which layer number, so I can design my experiments."
rewrite: As a research scientist, I want to create a recipe that specifies which material to use at which layer number; save a recipe; and load a recipe, so I can design my experiments.

text: API errors should surface as useful notifications and retryable error states.
rewrite: API 错误应以通知形式展示，通知需满足【待定：可测量的“有用”标准】；API 错误应呈现为可重试的错误状态。

text: User Story 6 (Submit Booking Request): As any user, I want to be able to select an available room and time slot to create a new booking. If I am a guest, I will be prompted for my email address.
rewrite: 作为任意用户，我希望能够选择一个可用房间；我希望能够选择一个可用时间段；以便创建新的预订。如果我是访客，系统将提示我输入电子邮件地址。

text: Opening the app should immediately allow users to finish today's attendance.
rewrite: 打开应用后，用户应在【待定：启动后可操作的时间阈值】内完成今日考勤。

text: Each command should have one clear, well-defined function
rewrite: 每条命令应只承担一个功能，且该功能需满足【待定：可检查的判定标准】。

text: User Story (Ben): "As a Student, I want a single place to configure the printer's IP address and the physical profiles of our pumps so that I can set up new hardware easily."
rewrite: 作为学生，我希望有一个统一的位置来配置打印机的 IP 地址和各泵的物理配置，以便在设置新硬件时，配置操作满足【待定：可测量的易用性标准】。

text: Tenant routing should feel automatic after login/register.
rewrite: 登录/注册后，租户路由应自动完成，无需用户手动选择或配置；【待定：可验证的自动完成标准，例如路由生效时间阈值或用户操作步骤数上限】

text: zenta export should produce clean output suitable for awk, grep, sort
rewrite: zenta export 应输出满足【待定：可检查的格式或标准，例如字段分隔符、行格式、无额外提示信息等】的输出，以便用于 awk、grep、sort

text: The app should be deployable as a static Vite build served by nginx.
rewrite: The app should be deployable as a static build served by a web server【待定：具体构建工具与服务器选型】。

text: Support for Pokémon Sets: Integrate with a database or a simple JSON store to allow users to use shorthand for common Smogon sets (e.g., "Lando-T-Scarf").
rewrite: 支持宝可梦套装：集成一种存储方案【待定：数据库或简单 JSON 存储等具体方案】以存储常用 Smogon 套装；允许用户使用简写引用这些套装（如 "Lando-T-Scarf"），需支持的简写集合范围【待定：需支持的简写集合清单】。

text: Reliability: The application should have an uptime of 99.9% and gracefully handle network connectivity issues.
rewrite: 可用性达到 99.9%；优雅处理网络连接问题，具体验收标准为【待定：要补充的内容】。

text: Security: All user data and authentication tokens must be handled securely. Communication with Firebase services must be over HTTPS.
rewrite: 用户数据和认证令牌的处理须满足【待定：需补充的可检查安全标准或阈值】；与 Firebase 服务的通信须使用 HTTPS。

text: User authentication must be handled by Firebase Authentication, supporting both email/password and Google Sign-In for users who choose to create an account.
rewrite: 用户认证需支持邮箱/密码和 Google Sign-In 两种方式，供选择创建账户的用户使用；具体认证实现方案【待定：需补充认证实现方案】。

text: Commands should work well with other Unix tools via pipes and redirection
rewrite: Commands should work with other Unix tools via pipes and redirection, and meet the following verifiable criteria: 【待定：需补充可检查的标准或阈值】

text: The error UI should appear where the user is looking (near the button or content area), not as a modal dialog.
rewrite: 错误提示 UI 应出现在触发操作的按钮或内容区域附近，而不是以模态对话框形式呈现。

text: The app can fetch public holidays based on country/state, but users can enable, disable, or edit them because college calendars differ.
rewrite: The app can fetch public holidays based on country/state; users can enable, disable, or edit them because college calendars differ.

text: Collaboration: Agents must demonstrably build on each other's findings
rewrite: Collaboration: Agents must build on each other's findings, with the criterion for judging whether an agent has built on another's findings being 【待定：要补充的可测量判定标准】

rewrite: Tool callbacks 应返回 Ok<CallToolResult>；从请求处理器返回时需提取 .value 属性【待定：需确认该属性提取是否为外部约束要求】。

text: Opening the dashboard should answer the questions students ask most.
rewrite: 打开仪表盘应回答学生最常问的问题；需明确【待定：学生最常问的问题清单】及【待定：判定「最常问」的标准】。

text: Error Handling: All errors should be caught within tool callbacks and returned as Ok results with isError: true, rather than throwing exceptions.
rewrite: 错误处理：工具回调中发生的所有错误都应作为错误结果返回，而不是抛出异常。

text: The plugin must register as a WHMCS payment gateway module, and/or an addon module as appropriate.

text: Customers can pay generated invoices manually via CoinPay, card, bank transfer, etc.

rewrite: Forms should prevent submission of invalid paths, status codes, and JSON before submission; invalid means 【待定：路径格式、状态码范围、JSON 结构的判定标准】。

rewrite: 输入将是一个 JSON 对象，其属性包括 attacker、defender、field 以及【待定：需补充的其余属性】。

rewrite: Customers can pay generated invoices manually via CoinPay, with the payment experience meeting the following measurable criteria: 【待定：需补充可测量的体验标准，如支付完成步骤数、支付成功率或完成时长等】。

text: The system must quickly and reliably prevent double-booking of any room for the same time slot.

text: Agent reasoning and tool usage must be clearly visible in a user-friendly UI.
rewrite: Agent 的推理过程和工具调用过程必须在 UI 中清晰可见，并满足【待定：可测量的验收标准，如展示位置、展示粒度、可见性判定条件】。

text: Retries must not create duplicate Attempts or child Runs, and every retry must be written to the audit log.
rewrite: 重试不得产生重复的 Attempts 或 child Runs；每次重试都必须写入审计日志。

text: Plugin must send final payable amount including taxes, shipping, and discounts; it must also email the merchant a daily summary.
rewrite: Plugin must send the final payable amount including taxes, shipping, and discounts; it must also email the merchant a daily summary.
